SELECT a.session_id, a.parent_session_id, a.session_name, a.create_time, a.creator_id, a.object_type, a.object_id, a.enterprise_id, a.session_content, a.is_debug, a.session_type, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.state, a.project_id, b.project_name, r.avatar
, 'DIGITAL_EMPLOYEE' AS match_type , NULL AS match_text , ( SELECT employee.resource_id FROM ss_resource employee WHERE employee.resource_biz_type = 'DIG_EMPLOYEE' AND ( employee.resource_id = a.object_id OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM byai_session_member member WHERE member.session_id = a.session_id AND member.mem_obj_type = 'AGENT' AND member.mem_obj_id = employee.resource_id ) ) AND LOWER(COALESCE(employee.resource_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(employee.resource_desc, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keywordLike}), '%') ESCAPE CHR(92) ORDER BY employee.resource_id LIMIT 1 ) AS matched_employee_id , ( SELECT employee.resource_name FROM ss_resource employee WHERE employee.resource_biz_type = 'DIG_EMPLOYEE' AND ( employee.resource_id = a.object_id OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM byai_session_member member WHERE member.session_id = a.session_id AND member.mem_obj_type = 'AGENT' AND member.mem_obj_id = employee.resource_id ) ) AND LOWER(COALESCE(employee.resource_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(employee.resource_desc, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keywordLike}), '%') ESCAPE CHR(92) ORDER BY employee.resource_id LIMIT 1 ) AS matched_employee_name , ( SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(employee.resource_name, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keywordLike}), '%') ESCAPE CHR(92) THEN 'NAME' ELSE 'DESCRIPTION' END FROM ss_resource employee WHERE employee.resource_biz_type = 'DIG_EMPLOYEE' AND ( employee.resource_id = a.object_id OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM byai_session_member member WHERE member.session_id = a.session_id AND member.mem_obj_type = 'AGENT' AND member.mem_obj_id = employee.resource_id ) ) AND LOWER(COALESCE(employee.resource_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(employee.resource_desc, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keywordLike}), '%') ESCAPE CHR(92) ORDER BY employee.resource_id LIMIT 1 ) AS matched_employee_match_field , ( SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(employee.resource_name, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keywordLike}), '%') ESCAPE CHR(92) THEN employee.resource_name WHEN POSITION(LOWER(#{keyword}) IN LOWER(COALESCE(employee.resource_desc, ''))) > 48 THEN CONCAT('…', SUBSTRING( employee.resource_desc FROM POSITION(LOWER(#{keyword}) IN LOWER(COALESCE(employee.resource_desc, ''))) - 47 FOR 160 )) ELSE SUBSTRING(employee.resource_desc FROM 1 FOR 160) END FROM ss_resource employee WHERE employee.resource_biz_type = 'DIG_EMPLOYEE' AND ( employee.resource_id = a.object_id OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM byai_session_member member WHERE member.session_id = a.session_id AND member.mem_obj_type = 'AGENT' AND member.mem_obj_id = employee.resource_id ) ) AND LOWER(COALESCE(employee.resource_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(employee.resource_desc, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keywordLike}), '%') ESCAPE CHR(92) ORDER BY employee.resource_id LIMIT 1 ) AS matched_employee_match_text
, 'CHAT_CONTENT' AS match_type , ( SELECT CASE WHEN POSITION(LOWER(#{keyword}) IN LOWER(message.message_content)) > 48 THEN CONCAT('…', SUBSTRING( message.message_content FROM POSITION(LOWER(#{keyword}) IN LOWER(message.message_content)) - 47 FOR 160 )) ELSE SUBSTRING(message.message_content FROM 1 FOR 160) END FROM byai_message message WHERE message.session_id = a.session_id AND message.archived_at IS NULL AND message."usage" IN (1, 2) AND message.message_content IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(message.message_content) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keywordLike}), '%') ESCAPE CHR(92) ORDER BY message.create_time DESC, message.message_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS match_text , NULL AS matched_employee_id , NULL AS matched_employee_name , NULL AS matched_employee_match_field , NULL AS matched_employee_match_text
FROM byai_session a JOIN byai_project b ON a.project_id = b.project_id LEFT JOIN ss_resource r ON a.object_id = r.resource_id WHERE b.project_id = #{projectId}
AND (b.project_type = 'operation' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM byai_session_ext oe WHERE oe.session_id = a.session_id AND oe.ext_param_code = 'oploop_source_id'))
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ss_resource employee WHERE employee.resource_biz_type = 'DIG_EMPLOYEE' AND ( employee.resource_id = a.object_id OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM byai_session_member member WHERE member.session_id = a.session_id AND member.mem_obj_type = 'AGENT' AND member.mem_obj_id = employee.resource_id ) ) AND LOWER(COALESCE(employee.resource_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(employee.resource_desc, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keywordLike}), '%') ESCAPE CHR(92) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM byai_message message WHERE message.session_id = a.session_id AND message.archived_at IS NULL AND message."usage" IN (1, 2) AND message.message_content IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(message.message_content) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keywordLike}), '%') ESCAPE CHR(92) )
AND ( LOWER(a.session_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(a.session_content) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') )
AND a.creator_id = #{createBy}
ORDER BY COALESCE(a.update_time, a.create_time) DESC, a.create_time DESC
